# Oyoto

> Oyoto (written Oyotō) is a UK digital product studio. It designs and builds websites, mobile apps, AI and data platforms for founders and established teams, with work for Nike and Lloyds Banking Group.

## Core URLs

- Home: https://oyoto.co.uk/
- Services: https://oyoto.co.uk/services
- Case studies: https://oyoto.co.uk/case-studies
- Contact: https://oyoto.co.uk/contact
- Sitemap: https://oyoto.co.uk/sitemap.xml

## Services

- [Build web platforms](https://oyoto.co.uk/services/websites): fast Next.js websites with a content manager your team updates without a developer.
- [Ship mobile apps](https://oyoto.co.uk/services/mobile-apps): cross-platform Flutter apps, with the backend and infrastructure behind them.
- [Integrate AI & ML](https://oyoto.co.uk/services/ai-machine-learning): machine learning models and AI features built into real products.
- [Engineer data pipelines](https://oyoto.co.uk/services/data-engineering): data pipelines and reporting that turn operational data into decision-ready insight.

## Case Studies

- [Trakr](https://oyoto.co.uk/case-studies/trakr): AI-driven career intelligence and application tracking, in closed beta.
- [Lloyds Banking Group](https://oyoto.co.uk/case-studies/lloyds-banking-group): data pipelines and AI summarisation behind senior leadership reporting.
- [Nike](https://oyoto.co.uk/case-studies/nike): recommender and classification models driving member engagement.
- [River Life Church](https://oyoto.co.uk/case-studies/river-life-church): website and self-managed content for a church family in Bulwell, Nottingham.
